body:
Note: I have permission for these maps
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FOSSIL CANYON CTF
Original map: https://avicus.net/forums/85ac754e9
Original author: timaeusTestified
Thanks to para for helping a bit w/ yml! :)

I thought Fossil Canyon would fit for CTF so I modified it a bit.

Modifications:
1: Paths are added from the spawn to the flag post.
Example: http://prntscr.com/7n09px
2: Flag post! I changed the lake monument to the flag area, which is indicated by a beacon and a ring. Just walk up to the post and you get the flag!
Example: http://prntscr.com/7n0a30
3: The victory monument is here. Indicated by a noticeable flame and 4 beacons
Example: http://prntscr.com/7n0ab6

CTF and how it's different from CTW:
Point one, you cannot build or place blocks! Point two, instead of walking into a room and taking the wool from a chest and hiding in there, you walk up to the fence post and you get the wool! Other than that, there isn't any more differences.

This album has more info
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GRAYLANDS CTF
Original map: https://avicus.net/forums/0129aad02
Original author: Pavlo

This is pretty much Graylands but with CTF mods. Also, you can build!
CTF basic info is above (Fossil Canyon)

Imgur has more info
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BOOLEAN:
https://avicus.net/forums/20035cbf3
Expect these to be tested soon.
Feedback is welcome! :D

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Updated with Graylands CTF! Some changes I took into account from Fossil Canyon:
- You can't build (you can in Graylands)
- The teleporter at spawn is too OP (there is a bigger delay in Graylands)
- Too confusing (Graylands has signs at spawn to hopefully help people out)
